key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Twining vine from a persistent rootstock.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Broadly ovate to reniform, usually 3–5(–7)-lobed, cordate at base, hairy.

key_traits.label: Sepals
key_traits.text: Long lanceolate to lance-ovate sepals, about 18–30 mm, usually hairy.

key_traits.label: Corolla
key_traits.text: Large blue to violet funnel-shaped flower, about 55–90 mm long.

key_traits.label: Key
key_traits.text: Large blue-violet flower + palmately lobed hairy leaves + very long lanceolate sepals.
